# Path-signature-based approach to regime-aware allocation

A concept shared by **5** of the 14,225 algorithms in the [ranked algorithm list](../../algorithm_ledger.md#8c-the-ranked-algorithm-list-csv-import) (CSV import of 2026-10-27); its best-ranked member is #8,489. ## Description

Proposed path-signature-based approach to regime-aware allocation: Infer changing market states from available price, volatility, or macroeconomic signals and vary portfolio exposure by estimated regime; regime labels and transition rules require specification. This is a concept-level interpretation of the title, not a complete trading specification: the exact model inputs/target, calibration, entry/exit or rebalance rules, and position sizing are not fully defined here.
